_readme: Human control over the derived Hitchcock name glosses (see scripts/fetch-names.mjs).
Hitchcock's 1869 meanings are traditional and sometimes fanciful, so this file lets a
reviewer correct or drop entries without editing the fetched source.
suppress: names dropped entirely (a bad match, or a meaning too unreliable to show).
correct:  name -> replacement meaning, used instead of Hitchcock's.
Names are matched case-sensitively as the KJV prints them. Being wrong is worse than
being absent: when in doubt, suppress.
